name: Replit Database
line: Managed PostgreSQL for Replit apps, with separate development and production data.

free.text: Dev cap 20GB/GiB unclear; account may end after 1y idle; prod sleeps at 5m

cells.regions: North America, Europe, Asia, South America, Australia

sql.math: 10 active hours, 1 GiB of storage and 0.1 GiB of assumed PITR (point-in-time recovery) use come to $1.97. The $20 Core credit covers it. Direct database transfer is not priced.
After 5 idle minutes, live-data storage is $0.35. History and backup costs remain. The Core plan's $20 subscription still applies.

files.math: Replit App Storage is separate. This product is a SQL database.

jobs.math: Replit Database does not host job workers
